description: Marvares wears a plum short-sleeved outer court coat and draped mantle with broad gold patterned borders over a long cream patterned tunic with embroidered cuffs and hem. A round gold shoulder brooch holds the mantle; a dark belt bears circular gold plaques and a long decorated hanging end. One hand rests beside the belt and the other hangs exposed; dark brown boots show below the hem.
